map.劳动力含谁？: Who is in the labor force?
map.就业+失业（在积极找工作）人口，在校/退休/不求职者不计入。结果仅作经济学教学与: The employed plus the unemployed (actively seeking work); students, retirees and those not seeking work are excluded.
